turns.prompt: These are TopSpin integral exports of 1H-1H NOESY MAS NMR spectra of the drug Ceritinib in POPC membranes. 01ms.txt holds the diagonal peak integrals of the lipid groups at 1 ms mixing time, in the order of lipid_groups.txt (first line is the lipid name). 100ms.txt ... 500ms.txt hold the cross-peak integrals between each drug peak (ligand_peaks.txt, first line is the drug name) and each lipid group, ordered drug peak by drug peak and, within each, lipid group by lipid group. For each drug peak / lipid group pair, fit the NOE buildup A(t) = (A_ii(0)/2)·(1 − exp(−2σt))·exp(−t/T) with t in seconds, A_ii(0) the 1 ms diagonal integral of that lipid group, and the point A(0) = 0 included, for the cross-relaxation rate σ (s⁻¹) and T. Report σ keyed as '<drug ppm>|<lipid group>' (e.g. '8.6|CH3') under 'sigma', and plot σ per lipid group as grouped bars, one group per drug peak.

provenance: user data, varghele/1H1H-NOESY 0e2b517 example/ (Ceritinib in POPC); reference sigma recomputed in s6.noesy
